request.prompt: Scene: the Belfry, near view at a player's eye height, dusk, rain. An open square bell deck at the top of the tower, arches on four sides open to the storm. The great bell hangs overhead, cracked from lip to shoulder, with no clapper. Beneath it a tall gaunt figure in a torn bell-ringer's robe, with a rope wound round its arms, turns toward the viewer.

Each image is ONE single full-frame view of that place, filling the frame edge to edge: never a sheet, never a grid, never a panel, never an inset, never a caption, label, text or border.
